title: MagicMirror_MusicLearningCompanion Marketplace index, schema 2 (schema 1 still accepted)
description: index.json at the top of this repository, built and signed by tools/market_tool.py build-index. The Ed25519 signature is in index.json.sig ({alg, ctx, key, sig}); for schema 2 it covers "magicmirror-index-v2\n" followed by the exact bytes of index.json (schema 1: the bare bytes). Mirrors verify offline with the index key(s) named by the newest root.json (or keys/*.pub before the first root), refuse a serial lower than one they have seen, refuse installs from a list past `expires`, and check each package's own signature.

schema.description: 2 = expires + root + domain-separated signature. 1 = the old form, accepted during the switch.

serial.description: Goes up by one at every rebuild. A mirror refuses a list older than one it has seen.

generated.description: UTC time of the build, like 2026-11-22T00:00:00Z.

manifest.description: The package's manifest.json, exactly as in the zip.

source.description: The zip (a GitHub release asset of the author's repository).

thumb.description: The tile picture, kept in this repository beside the entry (reviewed with it).

blocked.description: Take-down: mirrors hide matching versions and refuse to start an installed copy. Every field an entry gives must match; minVersion blocks only versions below it; an entry needs at least one of id / sha256 / author (schema 1: id).

expires.description: Schema 2 (required there): after this UTC time mirrors install nothing from this list (build-index --days, default 30). Stops a 'freeze' (an old list served for ever).

root.description: Schema 2 (required there): the root/<N>.json version the list was signed under (0 = no root yet).
